product.title: Norix ATN101 / ATN103 Attenda Floor Mounted Platform Bed
product.body_html:
The Norix Attenda Floor Mounted Bed mounts in a corner, against a wall or free standing. Sturdy and seamless, the Attenda bed features a raised lip around the bed deck for easy clean-up.

  • Advanced construction for intensive-use applications in critical environments
  • Molded in high-impact polymer, then filled with rigid structural foam
  • Seamless construction with rounded corners
  • Easy to clean
  • Bolt-down installation for safety and security
  • Overall size: 40"W x 84"L
  • Mattress deck: 38"W x 82"L
  • Recommended mattress size: 38”x82”
  • Models:
    • ATN101 - Standard Bed
    • ATN101B - Bed with Bottom Closure Panel,
    • ATN103 - Standard Bed with No Mounting Holes
    • ATN103B - Bed with No Mounting Holes and Bottom Closure Panel
  • Available options:
    • Platform Bed Riser ATN102-K pairs with ATN101 to create a higher sleep surface and patient lift device compatibility
    • Headboard ATN110 mounts directly to wall
    • Restraint Rings ATNR01N / ATN-R06N and Removable Restraint rings ATN-RR06K-01 / ATN-RR01K-01 can be used with ATN101 and ATN101B. Restraint straps not included. Restraints should be used with a bed that is permanently fixed to the floor
    • Non-removable, tamper-resistant glides ATN-G103
    • ATN106-0001 Enclosure Kit for ATN101
  • Weight: 108-125 lbs, depending on model
  • Mounting hardware not included
  • Colors: Twilight, Cove, Sand, Sienna, Dove
  • Made in the U.S.A.

About Norix Attenda Bedroom Series:
Behavioral healthcare professionals have long recognized that traditional furniture is completely unsuitable for their critical environments. Norix Attenda furniture is designed to provide the strength, safety and cleanability required for the daily rigors of institutional living — in a sleek, contemporary look.

Safe, Secure...And Built to Last -- The key to Norix Attenda’s strength and durability is its advanced construction. Molded in specially formulated, high-impact polyethylene, each Norix Attenda product is structurally enhanced for increased strength and durability. Solid as a rock, yet featuring seamless construction with rounded corners for added safety and security. Each piece is designed to be attached flush to the wall or floor. Attenda’s rugged, exterior skin is seamless and impervious to liquids, including bodily fluids and industrial cleaners. The non-absorbent, polymer construction simply leaves no place for fluids to go. Chronic maintenance problems are washed away.

About Norix Furniture:
Norix Group specializes in providing high quality, intensive-use institutional furniture designed specifically for behavioral health care facilities, hospitals, jails, prisons, detention centers, and other challenging markets. Norix humanizes behavioral and correctional facilities, while building extreme durability and security into each piece of institutional furniture so it stands up to correctional grade use. Norix furniture is as tough as your prison or detention grade environment, yet safe for trustees and staff. Anchortex supplies the complete line of Norix furniture for patient rooms, classrooms, inmate cells, day rooms, lobbies, intake areas, chapels, dining halls, outdoor/recreation, contact visitation and video-visitation areas, as well as public safety furniture for police and fire stations that looks good and stands up to hard use. Norix meets or exceeds testing requirements for intensive-use institutional and detention grade furniture, and the everyday test of use at healthcare and detention institutions by people who don't necessarily have the best interests of the institutional furniture in mind.
